notes: OO .doc bootstrap: open CFB, read FIB, select WordDocument/table streams. WO: ole.rs OleCompoundDoc::parse opens the container and detector.rs flags Word by OLE class string; the FIB itself is never parsed (no fWhichTblStm table-stream selection, no fEncrypted check).
FIB bit fields (fComplex, fEncrypted, fcClx, fcStshfOrig, ...). Nothing in wo-msbinary models these; detector.rs reads only magic bytes and version heuristics.
OO assembles the .doc document model (text items, sections, stories) here. WO has no .doc reader beyond container+detect; wo-x2t has no source_format()=="doc" converter.
fcClx piece table: cp->fc mapping, compressed vs unicode pieces (fCompressed flag), last-piece bookkeeping. Hard prerequisite for any correct .doc text extraction; absent in wo-msbinary.
STSH style sheet (std records, built-in style ids, UPD chpx/papx deltas). WO styles live in wo-ooxml/wo-docx-renderer terms only; no STSH decoding.
Font table (ffb entries, panose, charset). Not ported.
Numbering: LSTF/LVL definitions plus LFO overrides. Not ported; wo-x2t docx->odt/epub paths only emit list info from OOXML input.
SEPX/sepx sprm parsing (page size, columns, headers refs). Not ported.
PAPX sprm decoding (indents, spacing, tabs, keepNext). Not ported; wo-msbinary has no sprm engine at all.
CHPX sprm decoding (bold/italic/size/color, fSpec, field chars). Not ported.
grpfIhdt header/footer bitmask + story extraction. Not ported.
TAP/TC cell descriptors, table depth (itapMac), nested tables. Not ported.
Field char run (begin/separate/end) + field code/result split. Not ported.
BKF/bkl bookmarks and ranges. Not ported.
Comments (ATRD/annotation reference + text). Not ported.
Footnotes/endnotes stories. Not ported.
Escher drawing containers, embedded pictures (Data stream), OLE embedded objects. Not ported; the .doc Data/ObjectPool streams are never opened.
Tracked changes (RPR, frd). OO reads .doc revisions; WO has nothing.
OO's .doc -> internal docx-model glue (the bridge into ASCOfficeDocxFormat). WO equivalent would be doc->wo-document; no such converter exists in wo-x2t.
Save-as Word 97 binary writer. Recommend never porting: WO export matrix targets OOXML/PDF/ODF; legacy write is a no-demand liability.
biff8.rs pass 1: SST (REC_SST 0x00FC) + BOUNDSHEET (0x0085) name/offset table; unknown records skipped by length. No fonts/styles/globals beyond that.
biff8.rs pass 2: LABELSST/NUMBER/RK/MULRK/MULBLANK/BOOLERR/BLANK/FORMULA(cached)/ROW/DIMENSIONS. Wired end-to-end via wo-x2t XlsToWoSpreadsheetConverter (F-208).
ptg token stream -> AST -> A1 strings. biff8.rs returns cached values only (stated scope note); no formula reconstruction.
Style/xf record chain -> formatting. Deliberately out of scope for the minimal reader.
SHRFMLA/ARRAY/NAME records not parsed; shared-formula cells degrade to cached values.
Chart streams (BIFF chart substreams / ChartEx). Not ported.
PivotCache/pivotTable records and the _xl5/_xl9 storage streams. Not ported.
ole.rs reads the workbook stream through FAT/mini-FAT chains; wo-x2t converter picks "Workbook" (BIFF8) with "Book" (BIFF5/7) fallback.
OO assembles an OOXML package (xlsx) from parsed .xls here. WO deliberately targets wo-spreadsheet JSON instead; this is the reference if xlsx output from legacy .xls is ever required.
OO orchestrates full xls->xlsx conversion. WO equivalent is wo-x2t::XlsToWoSpreadsheetConverter — same orchestration role, different target model, value-level fidelity.
OO writes real .xls files. Recommend never porting: legacy binary write is not in the WO export matrix.
Legacy .xls FilePass XOR obfuscation and RC4 encryption. crypt.rs covers OOXML (MS-OFFCRYPTO agile/standard) only; an encrypted legacy .xls fails loudly at record parse.
ppt.rs scan() walks the record tree of the PowerPoint Document stream (recVer==0xF containers recursed, unknown records skipped). No persisted-stream offset repair.
WO reads only the "PowerPoint Document" stream; the "Current User" stream (needed for correct latest-version offset on files written incrementally) is ignored.
ppt.rs emits one slide per SlideContainer (0x03F8)/MainMasterContainer (0x03EE) with real text; placeholder boilerplate ("Click to edit...", lone "*") is filtered.
Both atom encodings are decoded to plain paragraphs; no rich runs, no paragraph levels/bullets, no styleTextProp.
No escher parsing: wo-x2t PptToWoPresentationConverter (F-305, fidelity L4) emits zero-size textboxes for extracted text; shapes/images/positioning are lost by design.
Slide headers' master/layout/inheritance chain unmodelled; wo-slide's inheritance.rs covers OOXML themes only. ppt.rs actively filters master containers instead of resolving them.
NotesContainer text not read; WoSlide.notes stays None.
Slide timing/build containers not parsed; WoSlide.animations always empty.
Font entity atoms / embedded font data ignored.
Embedded audio/video not read; media OLE streams never opened.
Legacy binary ppt write; recommend never porting.
Legacy ppt RC4 not supported; crypt.rs is OOXML-only by documented design.

ole.rs (1,302 LOC) implements MS-CFB read: 512/4096-byte sectors, 109-entry header DIFAT + DIFAT chain, FAT, directory red-black tree walk, mini-FAT + mini-stream reassembly. Unit tests at ole.rs:734.
ole.rs read_stream_by_name + read_entry_stream handle regular chains, mini streams below the cutoff, and disabled-cutoff variants (mini_stream_cutoff==0).

model.rs BinaryFormat is Word|Excel|PowerPoint|Unknown only. F-402 requires naming every unsupported taxonomy member loudly; the enum covers just the 3 legacy OLE apps (plus WO-only xlsb handled in xlsb.rs).

detector.rs detects via OLE class-string scan of the first 4 KiB (Word.Document/Excel.Sheet/PowerPoint.Show). OO keys off CLSID + named streams (WordDocument/Workbook/PowerPoint Document); WO's heuristic is cheaper but can misfire on crafted binaries and BinaryMetadata is never filled (always Default).
Legacy binary decryption (Word/XLS/PPT FilePass, RC4 EncryptionHeader) absent. crypt.rs deliberately scopes to OOXML agile/standard via msoffice-crypto (native only; wasm returns Unsupported).

model.rs BinaryMetadata has title/author/subject/creation fields but detector.rs never decodes the \x05SummaryInformation streams — metadata is always Default; only ole_class + coarse version strings are produced.
The escher record layer OO shares across DocFile/PptFile/XlsFile drawings is unported; wo-ooxml has its own OOXML-level drawing model, which does not read binary escher.
